subject: One-off grant proposal for LaunchPad Labs cohort — billing path & packaging ask
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@launchpadlabs.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Sasha Reed <sasha@starthubventures.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: cohort grant & one-off billing path for LaunchPad Labs

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team loved the latency profile and the cost estimates you showed. We run a six-week summer cohort and are preparing the partner package for 14 startups. Two asks from our side before we finalize the partner agreement: 

1) One-off grant: Can Redwood provide a one-time consumption grant (not a recurring credit) that covers prototyping run-time for each startup (~50K tokens each projected) so they can complete a demo by the last week? We typically ask for promotional grants that sit on the account and are drawn down.

2) Billing path exception: For accounting reasons our sponsor wants the grant to be invoiced to LaunchPad (not to the individual startups) but recognized as a promotional allowance on each startup’s onboarding. Is there a way to issue a single invoice for the grant while still provisioning credit buckets per cohort member?

We're flexible on terms (we can accept an expiration window of 90 days and a usage cap per startup). Attached is our standard partner worksheet with cohort dates and estimated usage.

Can you loop in whoever owns packaging/ops so we can align on the commercial flow?

Appreciate it —
Maya

LaunchPad Labs
maya@launchpadlabs.com
(415) 555-0182

Attachments: LaunchPad_Cohort_Worksheet.xlsx
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@launchpadlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: cohort grant & one-off billing path for LaunchPad Labs

Hi Maya —

Really appreciate the worksheet and the detail. Quick answers up front: we can do a cohort grant and we have two execution patterns that customers use today:

A) Promotional grant applied centrally (single invoice to LaunchPad) + internal allocation: we issue an invoice to your org for the lump-sum promotional allowance, then our onboarding flow provisions internal credit buckets on the startups' trial accounts. This keeps billing consolidated.

B) Dedicated partner allocation: create a dedicated reserved pool (Redwood Dedicated promo) attached to a sponsor tenant — better for tracking and can support spend over a longer period, but requires a minimum commitment and a provisioning lead time.

For a 14-team summer cohort where the sponsor wants a single invoice and an easy provisioning flow, pattern A is usually the fastest. Ben — can you confirm the invoicing and accounting path (SOW + promo allowance) and whether RevOps needs any additional fields on the invoice to satisfy LaunchPad and the sponsor? Marissa — I’ve attached the cohort worksheet to this thread and a draft SOW template.

Proposed next step: Ben and I put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) with dates for SOW, invoice, onboarding, and credit provisioning. If we can agree today, we can have the invoice out by next Wednesday and credits provisioned before the cohort kickoff.

Thanks —
Hannah
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: LaunchPad_SOW_draft.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@launchpadlabs.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 10:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: cohort grant & one-off billing path for LaunchPad Labs

Thanks Hannah / Maya — looping in RevOps (Marissa) to confirm invoice metadata. For pattern A we need the following fields on the SOW/invoice for our finance team: sponsor legal name, billing contact, PO number (if required), SAP GL code preference (optional), and desired invoice date. Also please confirm:

- Total promotional allowance amount you want Redwood to invoice (we can convert your per-startup token estimate to a USD amount based on the model mix).
- Expiration window for credits (90 days OK) and per-startup cap.

I ran a quick back-of-envelope using the cohort worksheet: 14 startups * 50K tokens each * $0.0006/token average => ~$420 per startup, ~$5,880 total. We can round and propose $6,000 as a lump-sum promotional allowance to simplify the invoice. If LaunchPad wants a buffer or an overage policy we can add a 10% contingency.

Attached a simple billing matrix (promo_billing_matrix.xlsx) that maps the invoice line item to per-startup credit buckets and shows the provisioning steps. Marissa — can you confirm whether we should issue a credit memo template or a coupon-style code for each startup? In the past we've directly provisioned internal credit buckets via our onboarding API.

Ben
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: promo_billing_matrix.xlsx

Subject: Re: Request: cohort grant & one-off billing path for LaunchPad Labs

Hi all —

RevOps confirms we can support pattern A (single invoice to LaunchPad with internal provisioning). A few operational notes before we finalize SOW: 

- Invoice fields: Sponsor legal name, billing email, PO # (if present), and a single line description: “LaunchPad Labs — Summer 2025 cohort promotional allowance (non-recurring)”.
- Accounting treatment: finance will treat this as a marketing/promotional contra-revenue line; we need LaunchPad’s billing contact for remittance.
- Provisioning: we will provision 14 internal credit buckets via onboarding API. Each bucket will carry a metadata tag "cohort:LP-summer25" so usage can be reported per team.
- Expiration: default 90 days from invoice date. If you need a longer window we can set 120 days but would recommend the 90-day default for simplicity.

Operational to-dos for MAP:
1) Hannah: finalize SOW language and line item (by Fri 6/13).
2) Maya: confirm sponsor billing contact and PO requirements (by Mon 6/16).
3) Ben / RevOps: issue invoice and provision buckets once SOW and billing info received (target Wed 6/18).

Maya — I’ll attach a credit memo template and the small SOW snippet we use for partner grants so you can share with your sponsor. If you want the invoice to be issued to your sponsor but remitted by LaunchPad, note that sponsor must be listed as the billed entity on the invoice.

Marissa
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
